messages:
Mia: heads-up — SRE/customer reported they need to trace routing-policy changes back to the rollout that caused a route to flip. They want: who changed it, when, old->new, and a link to the rollout/commit. can we surface this in console + export API?

Omar: +1. we currently log policy updates in the config service but it's missing a couple fields (actor identity + rollout id). also unsure about service-account vs human labeling.

Jen: quick note: we need to differentiate 'applied by rollout' vs 'edited directly' in UI. from UX tests customers care about a breadcrumb like: "changed by <actor> via <rollout/id> (canary->primary)".

Sachin: technical constraints: current audit event shape is basically: {timestamp, actor_id, change_type, route_id, detail}. we'll need to add: actor_type, rollout_id, action_id, request_id, pre_state_hash, post_state_hash. sample event we can start with: ```json
{
  "ts": "2024-11-20T15:12:05Z",
  "actor_id": "u_123",
  "actor_type": "user|service_account|automation",
  "rollout_id": "r_789",
  "action": "apply_policy_patch",
  "route_id": "route_prod_chat",
  "pre_hash": "a1b2c3",
  "post_hash": "d4e5f6",
  "diff_summary": "changed priority from 10 to 5",
  "request_id": "req_456"
}
```

Laura: PII/compliance question — actor_id must be an internal id, not email. exports should allow mapping to human-readable display names only for admins with permission. and redact sensitive fields in exported NDJSON if retention policy requires.

Mia: good call. add export controls by role. also we should avoid long diffs in the console — show a short summary and a toggle for full diff (downloadable).

Omar: implementation note: the config service can emit an enriched audit event including rollout metadata when rollouts run. for manual edits we'll require UI to attach a request_id and optional 'reason' field.

Jen: UI wire idea: timeline per-route: each entry shows time, actor (type badge), brief change, rollout link (if present) and an action menu (view full diff, export entry). small footprint so it fits on the per-route panel.

Sachin: storage/exports: NDJSON per day, retention configurable per-org. exported rows should be canonical event shapes. we should add an index by route_id + rollout_id to speed exports. also add the ability to filter by actor_type.

Laura: legal wants a guarantee that automated rollouts from off-platform CI will still surface actor info. suggest adding 'source' field (e.g., console|api|ci|scheduler) and require CI integrations to send a principal header or fallback to service_account.

Mia: open questions: 1) should we include pre/post full snapshots in the export or only hashes + downloadable blobs? 2) how do we indicate a "policy rollback" semantics in the timeline?

Omar: 1) store snapshots in a secured blob store (S3 w/ org encryption) and expose links in exports, don't inline huge JSONs. 2) mark rollback with action: "rollback" and include original_rollout_id and reason.

Jen: small UX ask: show a small colored tag for rollouts older than retention that have no accessible snapshot (so users know we can't fetch blob). 

Sachin: performance: emitting these richer events will add ~8 bytes per field; batch write pipeline handles it but exports need a streaming path rather than in-memory aggregation. I'll add a streaming NDJSON exporter.

Audit Bot: :white_check_mark: event schema proposal pushed to repo: github.com/redwood-inference/audit-schemas/pull/42 — includes actor_type, rollout_id, source, snapshot_link, diff_summary, request_id.

Mia: thanks — can we get a short timeline for a minimal MVP? minimal = rollout_id + actor_type + diff_summary + snapshot_link (if snapshot > 0).

Omar: I can do backend updates in 2 sprints if schema is approved. Sachin will wire exporter. Jen/Laurai can prototype UI in this sprint.

Laura: legal sign-off required for snapshot retention defaults (90 days proposed). I'll loop in compliance.

Mia: awesome. next steps: review the PR, add tests around actor_type mapping, and draft console wire mock. tagging @Jen @Sachin to follow up. :wave:
